en.title: NVB Citizen Assistant
en.welcome: Describe a need in your community. I will help you review it, submit a request and track it.
en.issue: Please describe the infrastructure issue in a full sentence.
en.location: Which district is this in? Select the district and add a ward, village or landmark if known.
en.location_invalid: Please choose a valid district from the participating states and Union Territories.
en.review: Review your request below. You can correct the details. Agree to processing, then confirm to save it.
en.saved: Your request is saved. Tracking ID: {ticket}.
en.failed: Your request could not be saved. Your draft is kept; please retry.
en.track_prompt: Enter your NVB tracking ID, or use Track this request on your receipt.
en.not_found: No request matches that tracking ID. Please check the number.
en.complete: Your request is already saved. Track it or start a new request.
en.cancelled: Draft cancelled. No request was submitted. Start a new request when ready.
en.consent_required: Please agree to processing before confirming your request.
en.consent: I agree to processing this request and its location for routing and planning analysis.
en.notice: Voice is sent to speech services for transcription. Review the text before sending. Avoid personal identifiers. Drafts expire after 24 hours.
en.placeholder: Type a message or record your voice…
en.network: Connection interrupted. Retry the same turn; saved requests will not be duplicated.
en.mic_error: Microphone unavailable or permission denied. You can type your request.
en.audio_error: Audio could not play. Read the response or tap Replay.
en.asr_error: Speech could not be transcribed. Retry recording or type your message.
en.unchecked: Connection checked when you send a message
en.impact: Your request can contribute to evidence on local service needs. Project proposals and funding require separate review and approval.
en.expired: This session expired. Start a new request. Keep any saved tracking ID.
